rationale: Only confirmed SK-language procurement page of a systemic Slovak bank; durable entry point for VUB sourcing rules.
Intesa group e-sourcing portal covering VUB tenders, but behind supplier registration/login.
Erste Group Procurement is the actual sourcing decision centre for Slovenska sporitelna; public and structural.
KBC group supplier policy binds CSOB SK vendor onboarding; best available proxy, low signal frequency.
Site-search endpoint on slsp.sk, not a standalone producing source; use as crawl technique under the bank domain.
UVO-derived supplier profile exposes SLSP public-sector banking/payment contracts; recurring award signal.
JOSEPHINE is a live SK e-sourcing/e-auction venue used by private buyers; continuously produces tender notices.
Slovenska posta ERANET instance publishes qualification and sourcing events relevant to the 365.bank ecosystem.
Public contracting-authority profile; branch IT, cash handling and counter terminals are core in-scope payments hardware.
Group structure page: mine once for SKPAY/Cards/PB Servis entity names, then archive.
Supplier-binding code of conduct under vub.sk; qualification context, covered by monitoring the VUB procurement parent.
Generic Tatra banka retail landing page; no supplier area confirmed, weak as a monitored source.
RBI network page is entity-mapping context, not a procurement feed; revisit if an RBI supplier portal is located.
PSS profile establishes German/Austrian group ownership that decides which sourcing portal to watch; one-off read.
Bank homepage only; commercially relevant branch estate but no procurement surface confirmed yet.
Unconfirmed UniCredit portal domain, verification failed and no supplier area located; open lead not a source.
FinStat gives ICO/entity resolution required to query CRZ/UVO/RPVS by exact legal entity; reusable lookup service.
Bank directory to enumerate the full SK banking population once, then archive.
Platform operator reference list maps which SK organisations run off-portal competitions; mine once for buyer instances.
Supplier-side PROEBIZ database; value and access unclear, useful mainly for one-off vendor reverse-mapping.
ERANET operator page with client instance directory including private financial buyers; high-yield route to non-state tenders.
Buyer-hosted sourcing instance for a payments-relevant buyer; produces tender/qualification notices continuously.
Utility buyer instance, off-sector for banking/payments and URL verification failed; keep only as a structural template.
Cross-buyer searchable tender index hosting financial-administration sub-portals; strong standalone monitored source.
